<module id="fsm">
    <description>Detection Circuit Mealy FSM</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="IN">IN input.</input>
        <input id="CLK">CLK input.</input>
        <input id="RST">RST input.</input>
        <output id="MATCH">MATCH output.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
    reg [3:0]count;
    
    initial begin
      count = 0;
      end
    
    always @(posedge CLK, posedge RST )begin
       if(RST == 1'b1)
            count <= 0;
         else begin
             if(IN==1 && count==0)
                count <= 1;
             else if(IN==0 && count==1)
                count <= 2;
             else if(IN==0 && count==2)
                count <= 3;
             else if(IN==1 && count==3)
                count <= 4;
             else if(IN==1 && count==4)
                count <= 5;
             else if(IN==0 && count>=5 && count<=9)
                count <= count + 2;
             else if(IN==1 && count==5)
                count <= 6;
             else if(IN==1 && count==6)
                count <= 7;
             else if(IN==0 && count==7)
                count <= 8;
             else if(IN==1 && count==8)
                count <= 9;
             else if(IN==1 && count==9)
                count <= 0;
             else
                 count <= 0;
           end
     end
     
     assign MATCH = ((count >= 5 && count</implementation></module>
